body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal M_\eta\), \(\psi\in\widetilde\Phi_\eta(P)\), and \(\sigma\in\mathfrak S_2\), one has \(F(\sigma\psi)=P\) and \(\tau(\sigma\psi;P)=\tau(\psi;P)\). The map \(\bar\tau_P([\psi])=\tau(\psi;P)\) is therefore well defined on \(\Phi_\eta(P)\) and on every \(\Phi_{\eta,k_0}^{1\mathrm c}(P)\).
body.justification: The causal image is meaningful only after simultaneous latent labels are removed without changing aggregate ATT.
body.gap: Regular mixture identification is commonly stated up to labels, but the quotient-induced causal functional must still be checked before singular branch images are pooled.
body.consumer: The public \(ak\) package may report endpoint witnesses with arbitrary latent labels without changing the reported ATT set.
